weapon.rucka.desc: Swings in an arc in front of you
weapon.dzezva.desc: Sprays hot coffee in a fan
weapon.fildzan.desc: A cup that flies out and returns
weapon.zvono.desc: A sound wave pushes everyone back
weapon.burek.desc: A burek roll bounces along the ground
boss.kazandzija.intro: Nobody hammers copper louder than me!
boss.cesmarka.intro: This water is for drinking, not for you!
boss.direktorica.intro: This meeting is over. You are fired!
boss.pcelarka.intro: My bees are already looking for you!
boss.mc_bloka.intro: Turn up the bass, the block is shaking!
settings.aim.mouse.desc: Attacks go toward the mouse cursor.
settings.aim.keyboard.desc: No mouse: attacks go where you face, up/down tilt the aim. Menus: arrow keys + Enter.
super.title: Super ability!
super.subtitle: Pick one super ability for this stage. It charges from kills; fire it with {key}.
super.once: Only one super ability per stage.
super.rucka.desc: A tram rushes through the arena and bowls over everyone in its way.
super.cevapi.desc: Three rings of skewers fly in every direction.
super.dzezva.desc: A fountain of hot coffee sprays both ways.
super.fildzan.desc: Eight big cups fly out in a circle and come back.
super.kisobran.desc: 5 seconds of invulnerability while big umbrellas circle you.
super.tepsija.desc: Every enemy on screen is hit and stunned.
super.zvono.desc: Three huge sound rings blast enemies back and clear projectiles.
super.burek.desc: Two giant bureks bounce across the arena.
super.lokum.desc: Every enemy on screen is heavily slowed for 6 seconds.
super.fenjer.desc: Fireworks burst over every enemy and set them burning.
super.sudzuk.desc: Lightning jumps from enemy to enemy across the screen.
creator.title: Create your character
creator.name: Name:
story.intro1: Sarajevo. The Šeher on the Miljacka, city of ćevapi, coffee and good neighbours.
story.intro2: But one morning thirteen self-appointed bosses took over the neighbourhoods. Each made their own rules, and the city lost its charm.
story.intro3: Someone has to give the city back to its people. That someone is you, {name}!
story.intro4: Beat the bosses of all thirteen neighbourhoods, from Kovači to Dobrinja...
story.end1: The last boss has fallen. A new day dawns over the city...
story.end2: The bosses went back to their jobs and made peace with the neighbours. The neighbourhoods are free again.
story.end3: Thank you, {name}! The whole city is celebrating!
tutorial.move.title: Moving
tutorial.move.body: Move left and right with {left} and {right}.
tutorial.jump.title: Jump
tutorial.jump.body: Jump over the block with {jump}. Hold it to jump higher.
tutorial.double.title: Double jump
tutorial.double.body: Press {jump} again in mid-air to clear the tall wall.
tutorial.dash.title: Dash
tutorial.dash.body: Press {dash} to dash. Nothing can hurt you while dashing.
tutorial.ladder.title: Ladders
tutorial.ladder.body: Stand at the ladder and hold {up} to climb onto the wooden platform.
tutorial.drop.title: Dropping down
tutorial.drop.body: On a wooden platform, hold {down} and press {jump} to drop through it.
tutorial.attack.title: Attack
tutorial.attack.body_mouse: Aim with the mouse and hold {attack} to attack. Beat the training dummies!
tutorial.attack.body_keyboard: Hold {attack} to attack the way you face. {up} aims up, {down} in mid-air aims down. Beat the dummies!
tutorial.steam.title: Sewer grates
tutorial.steam.body: When a grate glows and hisses, steam is about to burst out! Steam hurts you and enemies too. Cross the grates.
tutorial.info1.title: Levels and weapons
tutorial.info1.body: Beating enemies gives XP. Every level-up, merge one weapon into yours and pick a buff.
tutorial.info2.title: Super ability
tutorial.info2.body: At level 3 you pick one super ability for the stage. It charges from kills; fire it with {super}.
tutorial.info3.title: Waves and bosses
tutorial.info3.body: Each neighbourhood has 5 waves and a boss. Beat the boss to unlock the next neighbourhood.
tutorial.info4.title: KM and the shop
tutorial.info4.body: Victories earn KM. Buy permanent upgrades in the shop. Good luck!
